snippet.title: SSBU Meiling moveset mod move list
snippet.description:
Meiling from Touhou Hisoutensoku is now in Smash!

She has no grab, instead having a small set of "C" specials, as well as her own command inputs!
She can also cancel her moves the same way as in her base game:
 - Normals (A moves) can cancel into specials and command inputs
 - B specials can cancel into C specials and command inputs
 - C specials can cancel into command inputs
 - Neutral Air can cancel into her other aerials

Download is on Gamebanana! https://gamebanana.com/mods/583913
